answer: Follow the invite tree and punish the root. Every account is linked to its inviter in a public meadow, and invitations carry liability: when a newcomer is proven fake, the inviter loses part of its stake and its willow score drops. A subtree with an abnormal share of bans is frozen pending a velvet audit, so a farmer inviting its own army poisons its own root. Real communities grow slowly outward; fake ones grow as dense self-inviting balls.
